tests_added: tests/unit/rising.test.ts: risingShare's endpoints and that it never rises; risingMs between the floor and the cap over a grid, and risingMs(GAP_MIN_MS, 1, cap) === 300. The premise: with risingTempo:false every gap and turn on six pods is 500 ms, each pod with T > 0. Convoy Planning (no levers) follows the curve: turn i = risingMs(500, i/T, DAY_TURN_MS), turns never rise, each gap = risingMs(500, p, PULSE_GAP_MAX_MS), the tail gap's p is 1, and the first gap is above 500. Pulsar (levers pulled): every turn is 300. All six pods: no gap, turn or tail gap below 300. Deterministic: two builds of Comet are equal. v0: orbit-week's schedule equals one built with risingTempo:false, and one with risingTempo:true (no day turns, so T = 0)
